quests.name: Scourge of the Downs
quests.objective: If you agree to aid Belnistrasz, speak with him again and hand the Oathstone he gave you back to him.

quests.name: Extinguishing the Idol
quests.objective: Escort Belnistrasz to the Quilboar's idol in Razorfen Downs. Protect Belnistrasz while he performs the ritual to shut down the idol.
quests.description: Waves of undead attack during the ritual. Talk to the brazier near the idol afterwards to finish.

quests.name: Bring the Light
quests.objective: Archbishop Benedictus wants you to slay Amnennar the Coldbringer in Razorfen Downs.

quests.name: A Host of Evil
quests.objective: Kill 8 Razorfen Battleguard, 8 Razorfen Thornweavers, and 8 Death's Head Cultists and return to Myriam Moonsinger near the entrance to Razorfen Downs.
quests.description: These mobs are outside the instance, around the entrance.

quests.name: Agamaggan's Blood
quests.objective: Venture to Razorfen Downs and acquire Virulent Blood of Agamaggan, then return it to Kog'thug the Brave at Bristleback Retreat.
quests.description: Click a Cauldron of Agamaggan's Blood to summon the Virulent Blood of Agamaggan and kill it for the blood. One cauldron is in the tent nearest the last boss (it may also be in other tents). Blood from Razorfen Kraul doesn't count.
